name: 86 Chaos 16.0.81 Employee Schedule Visibility Fixes
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.81 Employee Schedule Visibility Fixes
notes: Employee schedule screens now load published shifts by both date and scheduleDateKey so restored/imported schedule records cannot disappear from My Schedule or Full Schedule.
Loaded shifts are normalized in memory so employee-facing schedule filters use the same date key even when older records are missing one of the modern date fields.
My Schedule keeps roster-aware identity matching and Full Schedule keeps published-shift filtering without changing permissions, branding, or Firebase credentials.
Firestore rules, Storage rules, Firebase config, API keys, Auth domains, project IDs, storage buckets, and service account wiring were not changed.
